name: com.sinoagritech/research-mcp
title: SinoAgriTech Crop & AgriTech
description: Chinese crop genetics, smart agriculture & soil research dossiers and tables (20 free/day).

tools.name: search_research
tools.description: Search peer-reviewed Chinese scientific research dossiers and empirical intelligence in SinoAgriTech (Crop Genetics, Smart Agriculture, Aquaculture & Soil Science). Returns titles, original DOIs, abstracts, key takeaways, enrichment version (V1/V2.1), and canonical URLs.

query.description: English research keywords, material/drug/crop terms, or DOI prefix (e.g. "solid-state electrolyte", "10.13929/")

tools.name: list_topic_hubs
tools.description: List active research Topic Hubs and weekly empirical trend briefings in SinoAgriTech. Includes executive briefs, methodology highlights, benchmark targets, and key Chinese research institutes.

week_id.description: Optional ISO week filter such as "2026-W47"

limit.description: Number of hubs to return (default 10, max 20)

tools.name: get_paper_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve the structured English research dossier for a specific paper by slug, DOI, or numeric ID. Automatically serves V2.1 Markdown/LaTeX full-text when available (or converts V1 HTML content seamlessly). Free Trial returns metadata, takeaways, and preview; Pro API key returns full dossier.

identifier.description: Paper slug (from search_research), DOI (e.g. "10.13929/..."), or numeric ID

tools.name: extract_empirical_tables
tools.description: Extract normalized empirical data tables directly from a paper's V2.1 Markdown or V1 HTML dossier into clean Markdown tables. Useful for benchmarking metrics, materials properties, clinical outcomes, or experimental comparisons.

identifier.description: Paper slug, DOI, or numeric ID
